about: Working set imported from szd-htr by tools/import-working-set.mjs (ADR-010). Documents are chosen for the variety of their TEI profiles. Each was checked for well-formed XML, idno[@type='objectId'], pb/@facs on every page and a GAMS IIIF manifest that parses as JSON.

excluded.reason: GAMS manifest is invalid JSON (unescaped quotes in a range label), so the facsimile cannot load.
